title: Glossary & Quick Reference
description: The working vocabulary of Thermo-Reactive Window Shading Materials: Nanostructure, Composite, Yield strength, Fatigue life, Percolation, Sintering, Doping, Toughness.
definition: Glossary for Thermo-Reactive Window Shading Materials.
key_points: Nanostructure: Engineered features at the billionth-of-a-meter scale that set material properties.
Composite: Two or more materials combined so the whole outperforms each part.
Yield strength: The stress where a material starts to deform permanently.
Fatigue life: How many load cycles a material survives before cracking.
Percolation: The loading where filler particles connect into a conductive network.
Sintering: Fusing powder particles with heat into a solid part.
Doping: Adding trace elements to tune electrical or optical behavior.
Toughness: Energy a material absorbs before fracturing — strength plus ductility.
